title: Bridging classical and martingale Schrödinger bridges
summary: We investigate the martingale Schrödinger bridge, recently introduced by Nutz and Wiesel as a distinguished martingale transport plan between two probability measures in convex order. We show that this construction extends naturally to arbitrary dimension and admits several equivalent characterizations. In particular, we identify its continuous-time counterpart as the continuous martingale with prescribed marginals that minimizes a weighted quadratic energy measuring the deviation from Brownian motion.
